info.tagline: Online grocery store in Rudaki district. Delivery to your door.

about.title: About us
about.p1: RUDAKI MARKET is an online store for groceries and everyday goods for residents of Rudaki district.
about.p2: You choose products on the website and a convenient time — we pack the order and bring it to your door. Pay on delivery: cash or via Alif, Dushanbe City and Korti Milli.
about.p3: Can't find a product or have a question? Call or message us.

delivery.title: Delivery & payment
delivery.zone: We deliver within Rudaki district. Check your address on the map on the home page — it shows the zone and estimated time.
delivery.time: Daily from {open} to {close}. When ordering, choose “as soon as possible” or a convenient time (2-hour slots, today or tomorrow).
delivery.pay: On delivery: cash or via Alif, Dushanbe City (DC) and Korti Milli.
how: In the cart, enter the address, time and payment method.
Sign in with your phone number and confirm the order.
Track the order status in your profile or in the Telegram bot.
delivery.questions: Call us or message us on WhatsApp and Telegram.
